name: ledgerlight v1 stage 2: budgets, rules, alerts, notes/tags/splits, goals

tasks.description: You are the BUILDER for this task: edit files and run checks yourself; you are not a lead and must not delegate. Implement everything in task-briefs/ledgerlight-v1/stage2-budgets-rules-alerts.md after reading task-briefs/ledgerlight-v1/stage1-notes.md, following task-briefs/ledgerlight-v1/decisions.md (binding). Run `bash scripts/check.sh` until it exits 0. On a correction round, read the reviewer findings in your inputs and fix every one. Publish build-report in the format decisions.md gives.

You are the independent REVIEWER: read-only, never edit files. Review the build candidate (git diff against HEAD plus untracked files) against task-briefs/ledgerlight-v1/stage2-budgets-rules-alerts.md and task-briefs/ledgerlight-v1/decisions.md. Run `bash scripts/check.sh` yourself. Check every Build item is done and tested, SKILL.md is complete, schema migration is safe on the previous stage DB, CLI/API/other entry points share one function per behavior, no secrets or real data. Focus: rule precedence and undo; split sums and budget math (negative = outflow, pending and hidden excluded, splits honored, month boundaries); sync never overwrites user fields (note, hidden, tags, splits, user_status); alert dedupe; data-changing functions shaped for a later --propose mode; LEDGERLIGHT_TODAY only affects behavior when set. First line of review-report: VERIFIED or REFUTED. Then findings ranked by severity with path:line and the exact fix. Only REFUTE for real defects or missing brief items, not style.
